title: Mobile Wallet Failed-Credit Allowances by Tier
content:
Desk quick reference: what each **Mobile Wallet** tier allows after a credit to the recipient's wallet has failed.

## Retries (resends to the same wallet)

| Tier | Calendar days a failed credit waits for an instruction | Free retries (free resends) | Retry fee beyond the free ones (USD) | Most customer-requested retries per transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 7 | 1 | 0.99 | 2 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 14 | 1 | 1.99 | 2 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 14 | 1 | 2.99 | 2 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 21 | 2 | 0.00 | 3 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 21 | 3 | 0.00 | 3 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 21 | 1 | 4.99 | 2 |

## Redirects (to another wallet of the same recipient)

| Tier | Redirect allowed | Redirect fee (USD) | Most redirects per transfer | Redirect must stay with the same recipient, in whose name the new wallet is registered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | yes | 0.00 | 1 | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | yes | 0.00 | 1 | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Express | yes | 0.00 | 1 | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | yes | 0.00 | 2 | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | yes | 0.00 | 2 | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | yes | 4.99 | 1 | yes |

- The hold period is the number of calendar days a failed credit waits for the customer's retry or redirect instruction before Paloma refunds it.
- The retry fee is the fee for each customer-requested retry beyond the free ones after a sender-side failure; the redirect fee is the fee for each redirect after a sender-side failure.

*Hypothetical reading:* a Mobile Wallet Express Plus transfer has 2 free retries, at most 3 customer-requested retries and at most 2 redirects; a Mobile Wallet Micro transfer waits 7 calendar days for an instruction.
